$comment: WHICH PATH A HANDOFF MAY LAND ON, ASSERTED ON BOTH SIDES.
`destIsAllowed` is one file copied byte for byte between core-service, which refuses a mint
for any other `dest` (apps/core-service/src/auth/handoff/handoff-dest.ts), and the client,
which hands off a link tapped in a message only when its path is allowed and passes no other
path to a site's sign-in entry (frontend/src/lib/navigation/handoffDest.ts). A declared
duplicate (.github/scripts/lib/declared-duplicates.mjs), so the spec beside the core-service
Exact match, segment by segment; `{uuid}` is one lowercase UUID segment; no normalisation.
